2026 Merry Meals Mixer

Dec 02 2026

6PM-8:30PM 

*5PM VIP ACCESS

OHIO CHRISTMAS FACTORY 
4125 MAHONING ROAD NE, CANTON

STROLL | SAVOR | SUPPORT

Join your Akron-Canton Regional Foodbank for our third annual holiday event, the Merry Meals Mixer! Guests will be immersed in a unique interactive holiday experience at the Ohio Christmas Factory, while enjoying samples of the area’s finest food and dessert. Beautifully decorated wreaths and raffle baskets will be available for bid in our silent auction, and guests will have additional opportunities to directly support the Foodbank.

Tickets & Auction

Click here to learn more about sponsorship opportunities.

GENERAL ADMISSION TICKET

General admission includes access beginning at 6pm to a unique holiday experience. Enjoy samples of the area's finest food and desserts, a silent auction and beautifully decorated holiday wreaths and raffle baskets available for bid.

Your ticket purchase of $75 is equivalent to providing 225 meals to neighbors in need!

VIP TICKET 

Upgrade your experience with early access to the venue at 5pm, preferred parking, *NEW* VIP Red Carpet Experience, a signature festive cocktail, first viewing opportunities for auction items and an exclusive holiday favor.

Your ticket purchase of $100 is equivalent to providing 300 meals to neighbors in need!

Please note there are no printed tickets for this event.
